categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in aluminum composite materials and equipment manufacturing. Main products include aluminum heat transfer materials, multi-metal composite materials, aluminum-steel composite materials, and aluminum alloy composite protective materials. These are used in automotive, air separation, power generation, engineering machinery, and consumer electronics industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced brazing technology, laminated composite material manufacturing, and precision rolling processes. Core technologies include layer-pressed composite material manufacturing, thermal treatment, and surface processing. The company operates modern casting, composite, rolling, and heat treatment production equipment with large-scale hot rolling lines (maximum coil diameter 2400mm, maximum width 3500mm) and cold rolling capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major automotive system suppliers such as Valeo, DENSO, MAHLE, Modine, and Hanon Systems. The company supplies to battery thermal management systems for new energy vehicles, traditional automotive cooling systems, and industrial applications. Over 70% of aluminum-based products are used in the automotive industry, with additional applications in power equipment, consumer electronics, and household appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. Major operating regions include Wuxi (main production base), Anhui Province (new energy vehicle materials project in Huaibei), and Guizhou Province (through subsidiary Leiyang Tianxiang). International operations include exports to Europe, North America, and Asia, with a newly established subsidiary in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It processes raw aluminum ingots into finished aluminum composite materials and supplies directly to automotive system manufacturers and other industrial customers. The company controls the complete value chain from material selection through precision manufacturing to quality testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-performance aluminum heat transfer materials for new energy vehicles, advancing multi-metal composite materials technology, and expanding production capacity. R&D focuses on battery thermal management systems, high-strength aluminum alloys, corrosion-resistant materials, and lightweight composite solutions. The company invests heavily in innovation with 2023 R&D spending of 177 million yuan.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of aluminum composite materials using an 'aluminum ingot price plus processing fee' model. Pricing is based on aluminum spot prices from Shanghai Nonferrous Metals Market or London Metal Exchange, with processing fees negotiated based on product specifications and market conditions. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's aluminum composite materials industry with strong market position in heat transfer materials and aluminum-steel composites. It holds over 50% market share in domestic power station air-cooled systems. The company competes with other aluminum processing manufacturers but differentiates through advanced technology, product quality, and customer relationships with global automotive suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 revenue reached 4.46 billion yuan, up 12.99% from 3.94 billion yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 64.5 million yuan. Total assets grew to 4.49 billion yuan from 4.03 billion yuan. The company shows steady growth with expanding production capacity and increasing market share in new energy vehicle applications.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced brazing technology, superior product quality, and high customization capabilities. Key advantages include 30+ years of industry expertise, proprietary layer-pressed composite material technology, extensive R&D platform with national recognition, and proven supply relationships with global automotive leaders. Products offer lightweight solutions, high thermal conductivity, and corrosion resistance for demanding applications.
